free_text: The statistical prior suggested no biopsy, but the retrieved evidence leaned towards biopsy due to the rising PSA trend (from 5.1 to 7.7 ng/mL) and the presence of a new, localized finding on the MRI (PI-RADS 3). The guideline criterion was undetermined by the panel, leaving the decision to the retrieved documents. The evidence supported proceeding with further characterization because the PSA trajectory and new imaging finding provided a reason to sample, overturning the prior's suggestion.
